test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

The Google doodle

P. with a cup of green tea, beaker and

Q. Tsujimura working in her laboratory

R. some green tea leaves by the side

S. features a graphical representation of
solution:
The correct answer is **"SQPR"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentences are in **jumbled order** and we need to make those in **coherent paragraph.**
 
• The appropriate order is as follows:
 
 
• features a **graphical representation** of
 
• **Tsujimura **working in her **laboratory**
 
• with a cup of **green tea, beaker **and
 
• some **green tea leaves** by the side
 
 

​Therefore, the correct option is **4)**.
